achievement_read.include_ui: Read-only opt-in: includeAchievementUi=true reads cached raw state and tooltip text from already-open summary/achievement widgets for returned IDs only. Defaults to false; does not open or refresh UI, and does not verify that the summary is for the current colony.
achievement_read.detail: Colony/Steam achievements: brief (default) or full with description and requirement types; no progress reevaluation.
achievement_read.filter: Filter achievement state; Steam supports all/completed/incomplete/unknown, not failed. Counts cover the full catalog.
achievement_read.not_initialized: Colony achievement data is not initialized
achievement_read.invalid_detail: achievementDetail must be brief or full
achievement_read.invalid_filter: achievementStatus must be all, completed, incomplete, failed or unknown
achievement_read.coverage: Colony state, not Steam account unlocks. Disabled/save-incompatible definitions excluded. Missing cached status is unknown; requirement progress is not reevaluated.
